mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 28 degrees with overcast skies near Harriet Park and a full moon tonight.
City tax bills are coming in the mail by December 15. You can pay in two installments, either by mail, online, or at the 24/7 drop box located at the City Center.
There is plenty to do in Verona, including yoga and live music today, trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow, and the Crafty Fair this Friday.
In a report from November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
You can satisfy your sweet tooth today with Dark Chocolate Decadence at Culver's, which opens its doors today at 10 AM.
